explication: Cilium is a Kubernetes networking, security, and observability system centered on an eBPF dataplane. A typical control workflow starts with cluster or operator configuration, reconciles node, endpoint, address, policy, and service state, then programs routing, load-balancing, proxy, and datapath behavior; traffic and telemetry are the resulting runtime outcomes. The tree also exposes API surfaces for daemon management, BGP, IPAM, policy, health, and mesh. Arrows are limited to explicitly visible calls or documented behavior; several major dataplane internals are represented at the paths present in the tree, without inferring their detailed wiring.
